summary: Admin accounts are found by names that end with your admin marker, and Drift shows only what PIM Manager owns.

new.title: Admin names can match at start or end
new.text: Recognised admin names accepts * at the start or end, so accounts like jdoe-a-id are found: Admin-* means starts with, *-a-id means ends with.

fixes.title: Drift lists only PIM-named objects
fixes.text: In an area with no definitions, the Drift page and mail list only PIM-named objects. A failed read shows as not checked, and administrative units have their own label.

fixes.title: Clearer commit status
fixes.text: After a commit, the status says queued and on hold instead of saved and waiting.
